records.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, 2012, ISBN 9787552800692; scan inspected
records.field: 日部 entry, printed p. 599 / PDF p. 612; headword, glyph sequence, and prose checked against the supplied scan. The entry ends on this page; the next page begins the unrelated 旻 entry.
records.text: Under the actual headword 日, the entry describes the graph as pictographic and its initial form as resembling the sun. It says later writing changed rounded strokes to angular forms, identifies the sun as the basic meaning, and proposes extensions to sunlight, day, daylight, time, and ruler. These are the book author's account of graphic and semantic development; the cited inscriptional examples do not independently establish the order or every semantic link.
